www.nvsos.gov.es: la Secretaría de Estado de Nevada

www.leg.state.nv.us.es: la ley electoral de Nevada (capítulo 293 de los NRS)

www.clarkcountynv.gov.es: el Departamento Electoral del condado de Clark (Election Department)

reg_deadline.en: By mail or at the county clerk: closed October 6, 2026. Online: through Election Day, November 3. You can also register in person at an early voting site or at a polling place on Election Day.
reg_deadline.es: Por correo o en la oficina del secretario del condado (county clerk): cerró el 6 de octubre de 2026. En línea: hasta el Día de las Elecciones, el 3 de noviembre. También puedes registrarte en persona en un centro de votación anticipada o en un lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.
reg_deadline.quote: By computer using the system established by the Secretary of State pursuant to NRS 293.671 , is the day of the primary election, presidential preference primary election or general election.

mail_request.notes: Nevada mails a ballot to every active registered voter; there is no request deadline.

mail_return.en: Drop it at a drop box or your county clerk by 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, when polls close. By mail: postmarked on or before November 3 and received by 5 p.m. on Saturday, November 7, 2026. The Secretary of State recommends mailing it at least a week before Election Day.
mail_return.es: Déjala en un buzón de entrega o con el secretario de tu condado a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre, cuando cierran los lugares de votación. Por correo: con matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y recibida a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del sábado 7 de noviembre de 2026. La Secretaría de Estado recomienda enviarla por lo menos una semana antes del Día de las Elecciones.
mail_return.quote: (1) Postmarked on or before the day of the election; and (2) Received by the clerk not later than 5 p.m. on the fourth day following the election.

early_hours.en: Each county sets its own hours. Permanent early voting sites are open at least 8 hours a day Monday to Friday and at least 4 hours on Saturdays. Sundays are up to the county.
early_hours.es: Cada condado fija su horario. Los centros permanentes de votación anticipada abren por lo menos 8 horas al día de lunes a viernes y por lo menos 4 horas los sábados. Los domingos dependen del condado.
early_hours.quote: On Monday through Friday during the period for early voting, for at least 8 hours during such hours as the county clerk may establish.

cure.en: Forgot to sign your mail ballot envelope, or your county questions your signature? You have until 5 p.m. on Monday, November 9, 2026, to sign it or confirm it's yours.
cure.es: ¿Se te olvidó firmar el sobre de tu boleta por correo o tu condado tiene dudas sobre tu firma? Tienes hasta las 5 p. m. del lunes 9 de noviembre de 2026 para firmarlo o confirmar que es tuya.
cure.quote: For the mail ballot to be counted, the voter must provide a signature or a confirmation, as applicable, not later than 5 p.m. on the sixth day following the election.

in_person.en: Nevada mails you a ballot, but you can still vote in person during early voting or on Election Day. Your county may set up vote centers where anyone registered in the county can vote on Election Day. If you already have a mail ballot, bring it to surrender, or sign a statement that you haven't voted.
in_person.es: Nevada te envía una boleta por correo, pero igual puedes votar en persona durante la votación anticipada o el Día de las Elecciones. Tu condado puede abrir centros de votación donde cualquier persona registrada en el condado puede votar el Día de las Elecciones. Si ya tienes una boleta por correo, llévala para entregarla, o firma una declaración de que no has votado.
in_person.quote: Any person entitled to vote in the county by personal appearance may do so at any polling place established pursuant to subsection 1.

first_time.en: Registered online in the last two weeks? You'll vote in person, at an early voting site or an Election Day polling place. Tell the poll worker you registered online before you came.
first_time.es: ¿Te registraste en línea en las últimas dos semanas? Vas a votar en persona, en un centro de votación anticipada o en un lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones. Dile al trabajador electoral que te registraste en línea antes de llegar.
first_time.quote: If an elector submits an application to register to vote pursuant to this section less than 14 days before the election, the elector may vote only in person:

locator_label.en: 2026 voting locations and drop boxes (Nevada Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Lugares de votación y buzones de 2026 (Secretaría de Estado de Nevada)

rule.en: The Secretary of State's map shows every early voting site, Election Day polling place and official drop box in the state. Each county also posts its own list.
rule.es: El mapa de la Secretaría de Estado muestra todos los centros de votación anticipada, los lugares de votación del Día de las Elecciones y los buzones oficiales del estado. Cada condado también publica su propia lista.
rule.quote: The following link (also provided here) connects to an interactive map of Nevada with every 2026 General Election polling place during Early Voting and Election Day, as well as all Official Mail Ballot Drop Box locations.

en: A current and valid photo ID that shows your physical address
A government document or check with your name and address (a voter registration card doesn't count)
es: Una identificación con foto vigente y válida que muestre tu domicilio
Un documento o cheque del gobierno con tu nombre y dirección (la tarjeta de registro de votante no cuenta)
accepted.quote: A copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, paycheck, or document issued by a governmental entity, including a check which indicates the name and address of the person, but not including a voter registration card

expired.en: Most voters just sign. ID is for some first-time voters who registered by mail or online and haven't voted for a federal office in Nevada before. A photo ID has to be current and valid.
expired.es: La mayoría de los votantes solo firman. La identificación es para algunos votantes nuevos que se registraron por correo o en línea y que nunca han votado por un cargo federal en Nevada. Una identificación con foto debe estar vigente y ser válida.
expired.quote: A current and valid photo identification of the person, which shows his or her physical address

without.en: If you're asked for ID and don't have it, you can vote a provisional ballot. It counts if you bring the ID to your county clerk by 5 p.m. on Friday, November 6, 2026.
without.es: Si te piden identificación y no la tienes, puedes votar con una boleta provisional. Se cuenta si llevas la identificación al secretario de tu condado a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 6 de noviembre de 2026.
without.quote: A voter who failed to provide required identification at the polling place or with his or her mailed ballot provides the required identification to the county or city clerk not later than 5 p.m. on the Friday following election day

who.en: Every registered voter gets a ballot in the mail. Rather vote in person only? Send your county clerk the Mail Ballot Preference Form to opt out.
who.es: Cada votante registrado recibe una boleta por correo. ¿Prefieres votar solo en persona? Envía al secretario de tu condado el formulario Mail Ballot Preference Form (preferencia de boleta por correo) para darte de baja.
who.quote: With the passage of Assembly Bill 321 during the 2021 Legislative Session, all registered voters will receive a ballot by mail.

witness.en: If you have a disability, are 65 or older, or can't read or write, someone can help you mark and sign your ballot. They note next to the signature that they signed for you, or put their name, address and signature on the return envelope if they helped.
witness.es: Si tienes una discapacidad, tienes 65 años o más, o no sabes leer ni escribir, alguien puede ayudarte a marcar y firmar tu boleta. Esa persona indica junto a la firma que firmó por ti, o pone su nombre, dirección y firma en el sobre de devolución si te ayudó.
witness.quote: If a person assists a voter to mark and sign a mail ballot pursuant to this section, the person or the voter must include on the return envelope his or her name, address and signature.

cure.en: If you didn't sign, or your signature doesn't match, your county clerk will contact you by mail, by phone if they have your number, and by email if you gave it. Respond by 5 p.m. on Monday, November 9.
cure.es: Si no firmaste o tu firma no coincide, el secretario de tu condado se comunicará contigo por correo, por teléfono si tiene tu número y por correo electrónico si se lo diste. Responde a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del lunes 9 de noviembre.
cure.quote: the clerk shall contact the voter and advise the voter of the procedures to provide a signature or a confirmation that the signature used for the mail ballot belongs to the voter, as applicable.

dropbox.en: Every polling place, including early voting sites, has a ballot drop box. You can drop your ballot at any official drop box in your county until polls close on Election Day.
dropbox.es: Cada lugar de votación, incluidos los centros de votación anticipada, tiene un buzón de entrega de boletas. Puedes dejar tu boleta en cualquier buzón oficial de tu condado hasta que cierren los lugares de votación el Día de las Elecciones.
dropbox.quote: Ballots can also be dropped off at any official dropbox in your county up to the close of polls on Election Day.

gear.en: Leave the campaign buttons and badges at home. Wearing a badge, button or other item that names a party, candidate or ballot question counts as electioneering, which isn't allowed inside a polling place or within 100 feet of the building's entrance.
gear.es: Deja en casa los botones e insignias de campaña. Llevar una insignia, un botón u otro artículo que nombre a un partido, un candidato o una pregunta de la boleta cuenta como propaganda electoral, y no se permite dentro de un lugar de votación ni a menos de 100 pies de la entrada del edificio.
gear.quote: Buying, selling, wearing or displaying any badge, button or other insigne which expressly refers to any political party or a candidate or ballot question to be voted upon at that election

phone.en: Take your sticker selfie outside. Nevada law bars the public from photographing or recording voting at a polling place.
phone.es: Tómate la selfie con tu sticker afuera. La ley de Nevada prohíbe que el público tome fotos o grabe la votación en un lugar de votación.
phone.quote: A member of the general public shall not photograph the conduct of voting at a polling place or record the conduct of voting on audiotape or any other means of sound or video reproduction.

line.en: In line when polls close at 7 p.m.? Stay in line. You have the right to vote, during early voting and on Election Day.
line.es: ¿Estás en la fila cuando cierran los lugares de votación a las 7 p. m.? Quédate en la fila. Tienes derecho a votar, tanto en la votación anticipada como el Día de las Elecciones.
line.quote: To vote during any period for early voting or on election day if the voter is waiting in line to vote or register to vote at a polling place at which the voter is entitled to vote or register to vote at the time that the polls close

tradition.notes: No 2026 Secretary of State or county clerk sticker page found. Carson City ran a contest for 2024 and Clark County hands out an Allegiant Stadium sticker, per news reports only; not confirmed on an official page.

early.en: In Clark County, the 2026 voter guide's in-person steps, for early voting October 17 to 30 and on Election Day, end with getting your "I Voted" sticker at the tabulator. Other counties set their own practice.
early.es: En el condado de Clark, los pasos para votar en persona de la guía de 2026, para la votación anticipada del 17 al 30 de octubre y el Día de las Elecciones, terminan con recibir tu sticker de "I Voted" en la máquina tabuladora. Los demás condados deciden por su cuenta.

provisional.en: It's a ballot you vote when something can't be confirmed at the polls. It counts if your county clerk confirms you're registered and eligible. If it was for missing ID, bring the ID to the clerk by 5 p.m. on Friday, November 6.
provisional.es: Es una boleta que votas cuando algo no se puede confirmar en el lugar de votación. Se cuenta si el secretario de tu condado confirma que estás registrado y tienes derecho a votar. Si fue por falta de identificación, lleva la identificación al secretario a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 6 de noviembre.
provisional.quote: The county or city clerk determines that the person who cast the provisional ballot was registered to vote in the election, eligible to vote in the election and issued the appropriate ballot for the address at which the person resides

line.en: Stay in line. If you're waiting in line when polls close, you have the right to vote.
line.es: Quédate en la fila. Si estás esperando en la fila cuando cierran los lugares de votación, tienes derecho a votar.
line.quote: To vote during any period for early voting or on election day if the voter is waiting in line to vote or register to vote at a polling place at which the voter is entitled to vote or register to vote at the time that the polls close

track.en: Track your mail ballot at MyBallot.NV.gov.
track.es: Rastrea tu boleta por correo en MyBallot.NV.gov.
track.quote: BALLOT TRACKING: Track your mail ballot on MyBallot.NV.gov

unsigned.en: Your county clerk will contact you by mail, and by phone or email if they have them, so you can sign. Do it by 5 p.m. on Monday, November 9, or your ballot won't count.
unsigned.es: El secretario de tu condado se comunicará contigo por correo, y por teléfono o correo electrónico si los tiene, para que puedas firmar. Hazlo a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del lunes 9 de noviembre, o tu boleta no se cuenta.
unsigned.quote: For the mail ballot to be counted, the voter must provide a signature or a confirmation, as applicable, not later than 5 p.m. on the sixth day following the election.

late_mail.en: A mailed ballot counts if it's postmarked on or before November 3 and reaches your county clerk by 5 p.m. on November 7. The Secretary of State recommends mailing it at least a week ahead, so in the last week, use a drop box.
late_mail.es: Una boleta por correo cuenta si tiene matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y llega al secretario de tu condado a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del 7 de noviembre. La Secretaría de Estado recomienda enviarla por lo menos una semana antes, así que en la última semana usa un buzón de entrega.
late_mail.quote: The Secretary of State's Office recommends mailing your ballot back at least a week before Election Day.

notes: Read October 21, 2026. nvsos.gov blocks automated fetching, so its pages (2026 Election Information, 2026 Polling Locations, Mail Ballot Voting, Elections FAQ) were read in Chrome; everything else is NRS chapter 293 on leg.state.nv.us (includes 2025 amendments): 293.560 registration, 293.269911 mail ballots to all active voters, 293.269919 assistance, 293.269921 return and drop boxes, 293.269927 signature cure (5 p.m. sixth day = Nov. 9), 293.3568 early voting hours, 293.3072 vote centers, 293.2725 first-time ID, 293.3085 provisional (ID by Friday = Nov. 6), 293.740 electioneering, 293.274 photography, 293.2546 line rule, 293.5837 online registrants inside 14 days. Day-of-week math: fourth day after Nov. 3 = Saturday Nov. 7; sixth = Monday Nov. 9. The SOS FAQ also says postmarked ballots may arrive until 5 p.m. on the fourth day (citing NRS 293.317). Sticker tradition not found on an official page.
